spec.description: Raspberry Pi nodes: CPU, memory, disk and temperature from node-exporter, plus each node's kernel log from Loki.

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (node) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var", node=~"$node"}) / max by (node) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var", node=~"$node"}))
100 * (1 - max by (node) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var/mnt/longhorn", node=~"$node"}) / max by (node) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var/mnt/longhorn", node=~"$node"}))

spec.description: Current values per node. CPU is averaged over 5 minutes; disk columns are space used.

spec.description: Composite sensor of NVMe drives (CM5 nodes only; SATA/USB disks do not report via hwmon).

spec.description: Kernel log lines per interval matching the filters above.
